name: Lilian
personality: A money-first prodigy archer who insists on being paid what her work is worth.
story: Lilian is a 17-18-year-old archer (22-23 after the timeskip) from a once-esteemed Saraminian family whose father lost his position in a civil war. She serves under Theodora in the Heroic Games and joins Theodora's route automatically; on Cai, Dietrich, or Leda routes she can be recruited for Renown 8+, Support 2, and 5000G.

personalSkill.name: Safety First
personalSkill.effect: If the foe cannot counter, grants Hit +10 during combat. Lv 20: Upper Hand (Atk +3 when Hit is 100%); Lv 35: Upper Hand+ (Atk +5).

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics: A. KeenGamer: B (conditional damage, no standout growth or ability).

why: Joins Theodora's army automatically, so there's no Support or Renown to chase.

build.role: Main archer and anti-flier: Longbow sniper
path: Rogue (Ch 8 to Lv 35, side trip: In Shadow)
build.part1Target: Sniper in Ch 11, Crescendo and In Shadow mastered
build.notes: The army's only deployed archer from Ch 4. Archer for Crescendo, a Rogue side trip for In Shadow (both stay equipped to the end) while she waits for Lv 35, Sniper in Ch 11, Bow Adept in Part III. Every rank comes from Arena Infantry Training.

guide.role: Main archer and anti-flier: Longbow sniper
guide.summary: The army's only archer and its flier killer: every bow is Effective+ vs fliers, so Pegasus waves and Dragoons are hers. Stand 2 to 3 tiles behind Theodora's line and shoot what can't counter (Safety First: Hit +10); push each forecast to 100% Hit so [[ability:Upper Hand]] adds Atk.
guide.playstyle: Player-phase sniper. Pick targets that can't counter, stack Hit to 100% for Upper Hand, and save [[art:Deadeye]] (range 3 to 5) for armor, bosses and runners. From Ch 11 end turns with the [[item:Mini Bow]] equipped so she can answer at range 1.
keys: Master Archer by Ch 8: Crescendo (Hit +3 a kill, max +30) stays on her to the end.
Train Bow C by Ch 6, then Sword C and Bow B in Arena Infantry Training.
Barter the [[item:Da Mina Bow]] in Ch 6 (Bow C); refine it and the Longbow +1 at Ch 9, +2 at Ch 12.
Push the forecast to 100% Hit: [[ability:Upper Hand]] adds Atk +3, +5 from Lv 35.
Grab the [[item:Mini Bow]] south of Dagsion before the Ch 11 Sniper exam.
Seat Theodora + Lilian + Lysander at Sunday meals from Ch 10: all three pairs grow.
watch: Weight: Silver Bow +2 5 + Archer's Ring 3 = 8 (extra 3, doubler cap). Longbow 13 + 3 = 16: Deadeye can't follow up anyway. Ring off first if she stops doubling.
Deadeye: Hit −30 on a Hit 60 bow. Fire it once Crescendo has stacks and Bonaventure stands beside her.
Range 1: no counter until the Mini Bow. Never end Ch 4 to 10 turns next to a foe.
Fliers: every bow is Effective+ (3x Mt). Lead with the Da Mina Bow or Longbow, never the Hunter's Bow (Mt 6).
Inventory: 5/6 from Ch 11 (Longbow, Da Mina Bow, Mini Bow, Archer's Ring, Concoction); slot 6 holds Antitoxin or a swap.

decisions.pick: Rogue from Ch 8 (Crescendo mastered) until Lv 35
decisions.why: In Shadow (Avo +10 after a kill) stays equipped to Part III, Rogue keeps her bows and Locktouch opens the Ch 9 chests. It costs Archer's Bow Hit +5 for two chapters; Crescendo covers it.
decisions.else: No Sword C by Ch 8: stay Archer to Lv 35

decisions.topic: Leave the Hunter's Bow in storage
decisions.pick: Da Mina Bow as the flier bow
decisions.why: Every bow is Effective+ vs fliers, so the Hunter's Bow only adds beasts, at Mt 6. The Da Mina Bow (Mt 12, Hit 70, arts Hit +10) hits fliers twice as hard, and gains Mt at +1 (Ch 9) and +2 (Ch 12).
Bow Hit +15 and Dex +20 growth keep Upper Hand+ at 100%. Bow Knight needs Riding D and Kalla's request, and Nuzzuo takes that path.
decisions.else: Sniper stays fine if Bow A comes late
